gloss: conventional, traditional; up to now, so far

definitions.explanation: Describes something that has been the standard or norm up to the present. Used as a noun modifier with の to describe established methods, products, or approaches.

definitions.gloss: up to now, so far, traditionally
definitions.explanation: Used adverbially to indicate that something has been the case from the past up to the present, often implying that it may change.

examples.japanese: {従来|じゅうらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{限界|げんかい}→限界：02715_genkai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are limits to the conventional method.

examples.japanese: {従来|じゅうらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{性能|せいのう}→性能：04340_seinou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}した→向上する：18997_koujousuru⟧。
examples.english: Performance has improved compared to the previous product.

examples.japanese: {従来|じゅうらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{枠組|わくぐ}み→枠組み：13117_wakugumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧とらわれない⟦{発想|はっそう}→発想：04309_hassou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Thinking that is not bound by conventional frameworks is called for.

examples.japanese: {従来|じゅうらい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手作業|てさぎょう}→手作業：12767_tesagyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}っていた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Until now, it had been done by hand.

examples.japanese: {従来|じゅうらい}⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}ない→問題ない：26594_mondainai⟧。
examples.english: There is no problem with handling it in the usual way.

examples.japanese: {従来|じゅうらい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{指摘|してき}→指摘：05630_shiteki⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ようやく⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An issue that had been pointed out for some time was finally resolved.

notes:
USAGE:
A staple of formal and business Japanese. As a modifier ({従来|じゅうらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧), it describes established practices, products, or norms — often in contrast with something new. As an adverb ({従来|じゅうらい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ / {従来|じゅうらい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧), it means "up to now."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {従来|じゅうらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜: conventional, existing (modifier)
- {従来|じゅうらい}⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧: as before, in the usual way
- {従来|じゅうらい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from before, for some time
- {従来|じゅうらい}{型|がた}: conventional type
